name: MonarchIcon
title: Icon
summary: An icon at a Monarch size, in the content color. Monarch bundles no icon set.
whenToUse: For Material Symbols exported as vector drawables, or the app's own vectors.
whenNotToUse: For photos and illustrations use Image. An icon is not a button; put it in one to make it tappable.
api: @Composable fun MonarchIcon(imageVector: ImageVector, contentDescription: String?, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, size: MonarchIconSize = MonarchIconSize.Md, tint: Color = LocalContentColor.current)

@Composable fun MonarchIcon(painter: Painter, contentDescription: String?, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, size: MonarchIconSize = MonarchIconSize.Md, tint: Color = LocalContentColor.current, mirrorInRtl: Boolean = false)
enum class MonarchIconSize { Sm, Md, Lg }

options.name: imageVector / painter
options.description: The icon, supplied by the app.

options.name: contentDescription
options.description: What the icon means. null hides a decorative icon from TalkBack.

options.name: tint
options.description: The color; by default the content color of the surrounding surface.

options.name: mirrorInRtl
options.description: Painter overload only: flips the icon in right-to-left layouts.

states.name: described
states.description: Has the image role and a name.

appearance: Takes the content color of the surface it is on, so it follows the theme without a parameter.
platformNotes: iOS uses SF Symbols by name and the web ships its own glyphs. Android has no system icon set that an app can reference by name, so the app supplies the vector. Sizes are fixed in dp and do not follow the font size setting.
accessibility: The content description is a required parameter, so the choice between a name and decoration is explicit.
A described icon has the image role.
Directional icons mirror with an auto-mirrored vector or mirrorInRtl.
edgeCases: An ImageVector created with autoMirror = true mirrors itself; do not also set mirrorInRtl on a painter made from it.
A multi-color vector is tinted to one color; pass tint = Color.Unspecified to keep its colors.

examples.title: A drawable resource with a description
examples.code:
MonarchIcon(
    imageVector = SampleIcons.Search,
    contentDescription = "Search",
    size = MonarchIconSize.Lg,
    tint = MonarchTheme.colors.textMuted,
)
